body:
Root-caused why array.prn's matmul/transpose were still wrong even after the loop-variable I32 boxing bug fix: the fix's own safety-net check couldn't resolve an interior let-bound recur value's type (strides-for's own 'next'), conservatively downgrading the whole chain to double. Fixed by giving that check's own let-handling a properly-scoped child EmitScope. matmul/transpose now verified correct end to end (genuine 2x3*3x2 product, [[58,64],[139,154]]). New make test-linalg-matmul. make test: 347/347, full regression sweep clean. Commit ee13e61.

⚓ ☃
title: matmul/transpose now numerically correct -- second, separate bug in the boxing-bug fix's own safety check
